place: Lynchburg, Moore County metropolitan government, Tennessee

facts.text: Lynchburg is best known as the home of the Jack Daniel's distillery, which markets its whiskey worldwide from a city with one traffic light.
Despite the presence of a major distillery, Moore County remains a dry county, though sampling whiskey is permitted on distillery grounds.
The origin of the name Lynchburg is unclear, with theories citing a judge, a resident named Tom Lynch, or a city in Virginia.
The downtown area of Lynchburg is listed on the National Register of Historic Places as the Lynchburg Historic District.
Settlers first arrived in the Lynchburg area around 1801, establishing early industries like cotton mills and a large tannery.
During the Civil War, residents of Lynchburg generally supported the Confederacy, with many serving in the First Tennessee Cavalry.
